decisions: Location confirmed from the site: Vaishali Nagar, Jaipur, Rajasthan (B-O, Vaishali Tower-1, Nursery Circle, Jaipur-21).
Reference slots: layout=moah-studio, type=noth, motion=airborne-studio, components=poch-studio, conversion=tagsen (new). All are inspiration_only.

Proposed a Print / Digital / Design grouping of the 12 services as an option for ux. It is not a design decision.
PRODUCT.md was an empty template, so research used the dispatch brief plus the site audit as input.
risks: The current site has almost no real content: services have titles only, the portfolio is theme demo content (lorem text), the blog is empty, and there are no numbers. The new site needs owner-supplied content or it will be thin.
The client logo wall (Govt of Rajasthan, LIC, Tata Hitachi, Eicher, Raymond, Healthians, Ensol, Shubhashish Geeta) is third-party trademarks with empty alt text. Permission is unconfirmed.
Positioning conflicts: 'Reasons to hire us' says the firm focuses ONLY on social media, while About says it is a printing firm since 2001, and there are 12 services.
Years in business conflict: 'since 2001' vs 'over 15 years'.
Contact email is Gmail and there are no tel:/mailto: links. Without a backend, conversion depends entirely on WhatsApp, phone and mailto.
SEO migration: /about, /services, /contact and /downloads are indexed. Demo URLs (/portfolio/*, taxonomies, /my-account, /author/admin) need 301 or 410 handling at launch.
Frontend-only static site vs the AGENTS.md default contact action (Zod/Resend/Turnstile): needs an explicit DECISIONS.md entry and a G3 DoD waiver for the contact-form E2E.
noth's 1vw root type is not accessible on mobile as-is. It needs a clamp() floor if that mechanism is adopted.
open_questions: Which service is the lead offer and main revenue source: print (visiting cards, offset), social media management, or websites/apps? Which 3-5 services deserve their own pages first?

Confirm the canonical business facts: phone and WhatsApp number (is +91-9024282878 correct for both?), whether to move to a domain email (e.g. hello@abizcreator.com), opening hours, and whether walk-ins are welcome.
Which founding year and 'years in business' figure should be published: 2001 or a later year?
Which of the 8 client logos may be named publicly, and are any of them willing to be a short case study (what was done, one-line outcome)?
May the 3 testimonials (Amit Sharma, Mukul, Chhaya Yadav) be reused, and what is their source (Google/Justdial)? What are the current Google rating and review count?
Can the owner supply real work samples (the /downloads PDFs: business cards, logos, portfolio) as original files with permission to publish?
Who is Aditya (named in a testimonial)? Should the owner or team appear on the site?
Keep or evolve the current brand (cyan/blue wordmark, 'Print | Digital | Design' tagline)? Is a vector logo available?
Are prices or 'starting from' rates (e.g. visiting cards per 100/500/1000) and turnaround times publishable?
Should the new site keep the Downloads page (GST certificate, brochures), and should the blog be revived or dropped?
Service area: Jaipur only, all of Rajasthan, or pan-India shipping for print?
next_instructions: Read CLIENT_SITE.md sections 3, 7 and 8 for the service inventory, the URLs to preserve or redirect, and the content gaps.
Derive the IA with one page per service or service group (company-site pipeline rule). The Print / Digital / Design grouping is an option only.
Plan tap-to-call, WhatsApp (context-aware prefilled text, per REFERENCE_BREAKDOWN §5) and mailto as the conversion path, since the site has no backend.

Growth: the current site has 0 h1s, no JSON-LD, auto-excerpt meta descriptions and no llms.txt. Plan LocalBusiness/ProfessionalService schema for Vaishali Nagar, Jaipur, and consider locality pages (competitor Digiwebart ranks with them).
Design-director: the measured motion, type and layout numbers are in REFERENCE_BREAKDOWN.md. Choose between them in S3; research made no design decisions.
